_comment: Per-author title exclusions for the Gutenberg harvest, in the textgrid_exclusions.json pattern. Two classes: anthologies and editions carrying OTHER people's work under an editor's name (an identity error), and the author's own re-chopped selections (a dedup hazard). Found by the anthology screen of 2026-09-12 over banks with verse>=250k or drama>=300k.

stevenson_burton_egbert.reason: editor; the volumes are an anthology of other poets

wells_carolyn.reason: editor; parody/nonsense anthologies of other writers

yeats_w_b_william_butler.reason: edited anthology of other poets; his own verse stands

francke_kuno.reason: editor of The German Classics: translations by many hands

browning_robert.reason: own work, but re-chopped selections that defeat windowed dedup

kipling_rudyard.reason: own work, selections volume; dedup hazard
